Example State University
CpSc 300 Challenges of Computer Technology (sample syllabus for tests)
Instructor: Dr. Alex Example
Email: instructor@example.edu | Phone: (555) 010-0123 | Office: Room 101, Example Hall
Office hours: online by appointment

COURSE OVERVIEW
This online course examines the social, ethical and professional challenges raised by computing.

DELIVERABLES
Weekly deliverables (assignments, quizzes and discussions) together make up a large part of
the grade. The final paper and presentation are worth
30% of the grade, so please plan accordingly. Regular deliverable submissions are
due on Sunday at 11:59 PM.

LATE SUBMISSIONS
Each student has two late passes. Once both late passes are used and the
submissions are consumed, any additional delayed submission will result in 70%
of the earned score.

GRADING SCALE

90% - 100% ......................................................................... "A"

80 - 89.9% ........................................................................... "B"

70 - 79.9% ........................................................................... "C"

60 - 69.9% ........................................................................... "D"

Less than 60% ..................................................................... "F"

GRADE DISTRIBUTION

Assignments ......................................................................45%

Quizzes ..............................................................................15%

Discussion .........................................................................15%

Paper/Case Study & Presentation .......................................25%

ACADEMIC INTEGRITY
All work must be your own. Violations are reported to the university.
